requirements.title: Morning brief generation
requirements.description: Morning brief (default 7am) consolidates: scheduled actions from all domains, experiments in progress, yesterday's summary, notable correlations. Delivered via UI (notifications P1).

requirements.title: Evening review generation
requirements.description: Evening review (default 9pm) consolidates: what happened today across all domains, compliance rates, notable patterns, tomorrow's preview. Quick one-screen summary.

requirements.title: Cross-domain consolidation
requirements.description: Brief generator queries all active domains for their contribution to the brief. Domains provide structured brief content via API. Dashboard merges and prioritizes by importance.
